description: Short two-topic interview transcript, in the [MM:SS - MM:SS] line format the real pipeline produces — safe to feed straight into the detect_clips stage.

output.transcript:
[00:00 - 00:08] Speaker A: So the biggest mistake people make when starting a business is waiting for the perfect idea.
[00:08 - 00:22] Speaker A: I wasted two years looking for the perfect idea before I realized the boring, obvious idea I'd been ignoring was the one that actually worked.
[00:22 - 00:30] Speaker A: Once I shipped something imperfect, I learned more in a week than in those two years combined.
[00:30 - 00:40] Speaker B: That's such a common trap though, how do you know when an idea is good enough to just start?
[00:40 - 00:58] Speaker A: Honestly, if you can describe the problem in one sentence and you personally have felt that problem, that's good enough. Stop researching and go build a rough version this week.
[00:58 - 01:10] Speaker A: The market will tell you the rest, and it tells you faster than any amount of planning ever will.
